name: ComparisonTable
description: Marketing comparison table with check/dash boolean cells, a highlighted column and responsive overflow.
designIntent: Comparison sections are hand-built with ad-hoc check glyphs and inaccessible color-only states. ComparisonTable makes the feature/value relationship semantic and gives boolean cells screen-reader text.

props.name: columns
props.description: Comparison columns excluding the feature column. Each column has a label and optional highlight.

props.name: rows
props.description: Feature rows with one value per column. Booleans render check/dash; strings render as text.

props.name: valueLabels
props.description: Screen-reader labels for boolean cells. Defaults to Included and Not included.

examples.title: With advisor vs. solo
examples.code:
<ComparisonTable
  columns={[
    { label: 'With an advisor', highlight: true },
    { label: 'On your own' },
  ]}
  rows={[
    { feature: 'Accurate valuation', values: [true, false] },
    { feature: 'Negotiation support', values: ['Included', 'Self-managed'] },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: A highlighted recommended column and mixed boolean/text cells.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use color alone
antiPatterns.explanation: Boolean cells already include a check/dash and screen-reader text. Do not replace them with colored dots.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for dense data
antiPatterns.explanation: Use DataTable when rows are records and columns need sorting, selection or pagination.

accessibility.implementation: Renders caption, thead, tbody, scope=col and scope=row
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a caption that names the comparison

accessibility.implementation: Check/dash glyphs are aria-hidden and paired with sr-only Included/Not included text
accessibility.userRequirements: Override valueLabels when the domain uses different terms

guidelines: Keep text cells to two or three words

compositionRules.relationship: Place the table inside a Section; it owns its own bordered surface
